description: Two XOR gates in 3HP, each with two inputs

inputs.text: One of the two inputs of that gate; a voltage above 0V counts as true and an empty jack counts as false

outputs.text: 10V while exactly one of that gate's two inputs is true, 0V otherwise

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
